concerns.text: SC-001 requires extraction accuracy ≥ 95% (proportion of correctly captured fields) on the 100-summary annotated set, but T007 only asserts the FR-031b thresholds (precision ≥ 85%, recall ≥ 75%, F1 ≥ 0.80). No task tests or reports the SC-001 95% field-capture accuracy criterion, so an anchored success criterion has no covering task. Either add the SC-001 metric to T007's verification or record that SC-001 is superseded by SC-031b.

FR-002 requires extracted records to be instantiated as ABSummary entities conforming to the inline schema, and FR-026 mandates 'contract tests must be executed against the inline schema definition in FR-002'. T004 validates only the AuditRecord output schema; no task validates extracted ABSummary records against an ABSummary schema (note three conflicting ABSummary schema files exist in contracts/). Add an ABSummary schema-validation check to T004 (or T001) naming the canonical schema file.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Removed as out of scope vs plan.md:Phase 3 V04 / Task Registry T099
concerns.text: Plan element V04/T099 (Constitution Compliance Audit verifying Principles I–VII in code and data flows) has no covering task. The 'Removed as out of scope' section drops platform-owned paths (justified) but does not address T099's code/data-level constitution verification; only checksums (T010) and re-run checks (T013) partially cover it. Either add a constitution-compliance verification task or explicitly record T099 as satisfied by T010/T013 with a mapping.
